messages:
olivia: Quick preflight—rolling regional deploy for v2.4.3. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Window: 02:00-05:00 UTC. Can we confirm capacity and rollback gates?

sam: US warm pool at 85% (reserved). We can do a 2x burst for canary.

ana: EU has scheduled maintenance at 03:30 UTC on infra-db, recommend EU after US canary + 30m.

ying: APAC capacity is tight in ap-southeast1, need to pin to smaller instance class for canary there.

olivia: Good call. Proposed sequence:
1) US (us-west-2) canary 5% traffic, 20m observation.
2) EU (eu-west-1) canary 5% after US green + manual signoff.
3) APAC staggered at 2% -> 10% over 40m with instance-class pin.

sam: +1. Set rollout policy: `max_surge=5%`, `fallback_model=v2.3.9` if latency > 350ms p95 for 3m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] initiating preflight checks...
- config synthesis OK
- model artifact hash: `sha256:6f2d...9a3c`
- reserved GPUs available: US 120, EU 60, APAC 18

deploy-bot: preflight result: WARN apac_reserved_gpus < recommended (18 < 24)

olivia: Noted. For APAC canary we'll pin instance to g4dn.xlarge equivalent and lower concurrency to 8 to avoid OOM. Add rollback window 0-10m if error-rate spike > 1.5x.

ana: EU maintenance moved to 04:00 UTC (confirmed). EU safe to run after US + 30m.

sam: I'll kick off US canary at T+10. @sre-oncall please keep eyes on token_backend errors and GPU OOMs.

sre-oncall: Oncall acked. Will watch logs and set alert for `inference.error_rate > 1.0%` and `p95_latency > 350ms` in paging policy.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] US canary started: `slice=us-canary-5pct`, image=v2.4.3-canary, started 2234567895

sam: US canary metrics: 2m in, p50 90ms, p95 280ms, error_rate 0.12%. No anomalies.

olivia: US green. Manual signoff -> proceeding to EU after 30m hold. Move flag `eu_canary_go` to true at 2234567975 if no regressions.

ana: EU go confirmed at 2234567976. deploy-bot kick when ready.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] EU canary started: `slice=eu-canary-5pct`, image=v2.4.3-canary, started 2234567988

ying: APAC slow-roll prep: will pin `instanceType=small-quant` and throttle concurrency via `max_concurrency=8` for canary.

sam: EU metrics: p95 320ms, error_rate 0.3%. Within threshold. EU green.

olivia: Proceed APAC in 10m with pinned instance and conservative ramp. Reminder: rollback policy -> immediate pin to v2.3.9 and traffic split to 0 if error_rate > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] APAC canary starting (pinned instance) at 2234567990. Note: reserved GPUs low, using burst pool.

ying: APAC 6m in: p95 410ms (higher), error_rate 0.9%. Observing kernel preemption logs, increasing CPU steal.

sam: Throttling canary to 2% and notifying infra to shift warm pool.

olivia: Decision: hold APAC ramp, open a rollback window for 5m. If p95 doesn't drop under 350ms and errors don't fall below 0.5%, fallback to v2.3.9.

sre-oncall: Jumping in to repro replay on canary slice and check node metrics.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] APAC canary rollback triggered at 2234567998 -> reverting slice to v2.3.9, draining new pods.

olivia: Thanks team. Filing post-rollout notes: 1) APAC capacity shortfall, need reserved pool increase or quantized instance build. 2) Add automatic instance-pin option in rollout config. 3) Update runbook with explicit APAC throttle defaults.

sam: I'll open the follow-up ticket and schedule a retro. :+1:

ana: tagging infra to review GPU provisioning. @ying please paste the preflight logs to ticket.

ying: pasted logs and notes in ticket.

olivia: Closing thread. Good ops. :shipit:
